infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Reinnovation Scan uses the camera to scan rooms with ARKit/RoomPlan and capture inspection photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Reinnovation Scan saves scan photos and 3D models to your photo library if you choose to export them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Reinnovation Scan needs to save scan photos and exported models to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Reinnovation Scan optionally uses location to associate scans with property addresses.
